title: VirtualIP
description: A DNAT / port-forwarding mapping (R-003), modelled after FortiGate VIPs: external address[:port] on an Interface is translated to an internal address[:port]. A VirtualIP is used as the *destination* of a Policy; the Policy is evaluated on the post-DNAT destination. VirtualIP lives in the Address/AddressGroup namespace.

externalInterface.description: Interface (or Zone) on which the external address is reachable.

externalAddress.description: Literal address, or the keyword 'interface' meaning the primary address of externalInterface (handles dynamic WAN addresses).

mappedPort.description: Single port, or a range of the same size as externalPort (validator check).
